title: Logspace uniformity implies polynomial size
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. If $C$ is logspace-uniform, then there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that $\mathrm{size}(C_n)\leq a(n+1)^k$ for every $n$.
